test_title: PYST 16: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : TVS :: IKH : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : TVS :: IKH : %

Option 1) # = KNV, % = FXC → KNV : TVS :: IKH : FXC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/123699dc268978b9fdb40354483fae097bbd48e131979f7529dee3145cc849bd.png] 

Option 2) # = WOZ, % = UQE → WOZ : TVS :: IKH : UQE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4e5b39123e616b1da3dab55c8c205a08831d5db5b278268f23f2f88852ab9cc.png] 

Option 3) # = WYV, % = FHE → WYV : TVS :: IKH : FHE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c928d503b6dac08f073be0f85b2f54807a101181f5162c5b89822e20eeeb2f5.png] 

Option 4) # = IOV, % = WEE → IOV : TVS :: IKH : WEE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b851fc0ff49ec9760854d9b52165c4165dcfc51a7fa1370e6ae825b8d397b20.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
